get.description:
Retrieves patient summary accessible to an authorized family caregiver.

Security & Attack Mitigations:
- Rejects invalid / non-existent tokens with HTTP 404.
- Rejects revoked tokens with HTTP 403 Forbidden.
- Rejects expired tokens with HTTP 403 Forbidden.
- Rejects access if patient has withdrawn active clinical consent with HTTP 403 Forbidden.
- Strictly limits disclosed fields according to granted scope ('view_summary' vs 'full_history').
- Hash-chained audit event recorded for every caregiver access.
get.summary: Access patient summary via scoped caregiver share token

post.description:
Clinician-confirmed schedule re-allocation.

Enforces:
- Clinician oversight and authentication
- Writes immutable DelayLedgerEntry records for moved/delayed treatments
- Updates scheduled start date and assigned machine on the course
- Records hash-chained audit event continuity.schedule_confirmed

Solves the multi-machine radiotherapy scheduling problem via Google OR-Tools CP-SAT.

Enforces:
- Hard machine slot capacity limits per day
- Machine maintenance and breakdown downtime
- Course contiguity (fractions delivered on consecutive days)
- Clinical urgency ceilings (emergency ≤ 3d, urgent ≤ 7d)
- Algorithmic fairness: bounded delay disparity across subgroups (≤ disparity_bound)
- No-starvation: maximum waiting time bounded by max_wait_days

post.description:
Executes a retrospective missed-signal quality audit (M10).

Access Control:
- Restricted to quality_lead and admin roles.
- Clinicians, nurse clerks, radiographers, patients, and caregivers are rejected with 403.

Privacy & Register:
- Small-cell suppression (k >= 5) on all demographic and clinical breakdown strata.
- Strictly neutral descriptive register ('signal present, action not recorded').
- Zero clinician or identifiable patient information returned.
- Chained AuditEvent recorded for institutional auditability.
